passages.quote:
Both employers and employees can get confidential help and advice on employment rights from Acas (the Advisory, Conciliation and Arbitration Service).

Employees can also talk to Citizens Advice or their trade union representative.

For more detailed information, read Employment rights on the transfer of an undertaking.

Employment tribunals

If an employee feels they have been dismissed unfairly, or feel forced to resign, they may be able to complain to an employment tribunal.
